newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates -Mid-Mississippi River still weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates -Mid-Mississippi River still weak.

text.p: U.S. barge rates continued to show weakness in offers posted for the mid-Mississippi River Wednesday during the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded versus none Tuesday. Bids and offers included:
- Eight barges, two each week April, mid-Mississippi offered 7-1/2 points lower at 132-1/2 percent of tariff, no bid.
- Four barges, one each week May, mid-Mississippi bid at 120 percent, offered at 125 percent (based on two each week), no comparisons.
- Four barges, one each week October, mid-Mississippi offered five points lower at 240 percent, bid at 232-1/2 percent.
- Four barges, one each week October, upper Mississippi (LaCrosse-Savage) bid at 250 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Four barges, one each week October, Mississippi (Osceola-Cairo) offered at 202-1/2 percent, no bid or comparison.
